details: Bitcoin surged 25% in August, briefly crossing $80,000, and Ethereum also saw significant weekly gains, reclaiming $2,500. This rally is fueled by substantial net inflows into US spot Bitcoin and Ethereum exchange-traded funds (ETFs), with over $3 billion in new capital since August 17, indicating renewed institutional interest.
title: Bitcoin & Ethereum Rally on Strong ETF Inflows

details: Crypto markets experienced a broad sell-off, with Bitcoin briefly falling below $77,000, and Ethereum dropping 3.5%, following hawkish remarks from Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh at the Jackson Hole symposium. This macro sentiment, combined with a significant $6.4 billion Bitcoin options expiry, contributed to market volatility and liquidations across the sector.
title: Fed Hawkishness & Options Expiry Trigger Crypto Market Dip

details: Charles Schwab will expand its retail crypto trading platform by adding Solana (SOL), Avalanche (AVAX), and Chainlink (LINK) in the coming months. This move by the major brokerage, which already offers Bitcoin and Ethereum, will provide its 39.9 million active accounts access to these altcoins, signifying growing institutional adoption.
title: Charles Schwab to Add Solana, Avalanche, Chainlink Trading

details: Fundstrat's Tom Lee forecasts Ethereum (ETH) could reach $6,000 by year-end, contingent on Bitcoin hitting $150,000. He highlights real-world asset tokenization and AI agents utilizing crypto rails for payments as significant growth drivers, emphasizing Ethereum's undervalued status despite recent rallies.
title: Fundstrat's Tom Lee Predicts Ethereum to Hit $6,000

details: The U.S. SEC's proposal to update crypto custody rules for investment advisers has been sent to the White House for review, aiming to clarify how digital assets can be held. Separately, South Korea's Shinhan Financial Group and Visa are collaborating to test stablecoin banking rails for various payment services, indicating increasing institutional interest in stablecoin utility.
title: SEC Advances Crypto Custody Rules; Shinhan & Visa Test Stablecoins

details: Polymarket US, through QCEX, has self-certified new CFTC rules to list Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana price event contracts. These derivatives could be available to U.S. users as early as August 28, providing a regulated avenue for crypto speculation and potentially boosting mainstream adoption.
title: Polymarket US to Launch CFTC-Approved Crypto Event Contracts

details: altFINS and BitPath Holdings have announced a strategic partnership to launch a "Gen 2 Digital Asset Treasury" strategy. This initiative will provide institutional-grade crypto analytics and active portfolio management, aiming to redefine corporate treasury management beyond traditional "buy and hold" with diversified, AI-driven crypto asset baskets.
title: altFINS & BitPath Partner for AI-Driven Crypto Treasury Strategy
